Class GroveDht11

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.sensors.GroveDht11
public final class GroveDht11 extends Object
Reads Seeed's Grove Temperature & Humidity Sensor (DHT11). The DHT11 frame stores whole-number humidity and temperature values. The caller owns and reuses both buffers; this driver allocates nothing.

Allow at least one second between readings. The monitor in the examples waits two seconds, which also works for DHT22-format modules.

  • Method Details

    • read

      public boolean read(int signalPin, int[] reading, int readingLength, int[] frame, int frameLength)
      Reads one checksum-valid DHT11 frame using caller-owned buffers.
      Parameters:
      signalPin - digital Grove signal pin
      reading - caller-owned temperature/humidity result
      readingLength - writable result slots, at least READING_LENGTH
      frame - caller-owned raw frame buffer
      frameLength - writable frame slots, at least FRAME_LENGTH
      Returns:
      whether a plausible DHT11 frame was read
